notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.notes:
v Beta 0.6
[DungeonPedia] DungeonPedia offers now beautiful designed History articles. Also allows video content.
[Combat] Fixed Hit enemy animation when doing a power attack.

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.notes:
v Beta 0.5.2
 [New Feature - Throw Gold] Player can Throw his own Gold to distract/control enemies.
 [Gameplay] Improved Tutorial.
 [SFX] Improved ingame overall SFX.
 [BugFixing] Fixed  a bunch of small bugs.

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.notes:
v Bta 0.5.1
[Localization]   Korean Language added!
[Steam User BUG]  Player was grappled even standing under an enemy and jumping trying to attack. 
[Improvement]  Adjusted enemy hitboxes for more accurate and satisfying hits.
[Improvement]  DPS System: Hitting fast enemies will stun them.
[Gameplay]  Bag can now store 4 Sacred Texts at Level 0
[Gameplay]  Falling from a deadly height won't kill the player, but it will reduce their Faith to only 5 points.
[Gameplay]  No more automatic gold! You must now interact with enemy corpses to collect their gold.
[BUG]  Levels with Mountain Breach had a wrong starting Player position.

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.notes:
v. Beta 0.5
 [Gameplay]   New Tower Tutorial explaining the Game Basics. 
 [Gameplay]   New improved  Level 1 Tutorial with faster loading time.
 [Gameplay]   Faster interaction times for the DEMO/BETA.
 [UI]   What Happened? window with a recap for those skipping the Game Introduction at Jerusalem.
 [UI]   Now Pressing ESC in Jerusalem menus will take you BACK.
 [UI]   Faster transition when entering the Library  (no more inspirational quotes)

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.notes:
[Bug]  Fixed the that Player couldn't fire a torch in First Door Level.
[Feature] Added more options in Game Settings.
[Audio] No AI Voices: For those that can't stand AI-generated voices.
[Audio]  Subtitles: You can now hide subtitles if you want.
[Settings] Head Bob option for players with Motion Sickness.
 [Controllers]  Gamepad is no longer auto-detected, so players need to manually activate it in Game Settings.
[Controllers]  Game now has support for AZERTY keyboards.
[STEAMDECK]  When playing on a SteamDeck player can't change resolution or deactivate the GamePad.

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.notes:
[Bug] New FP Animations created the bug that Off wall torches  were still giving light to player Torch.
[Localization] Localization Improvements.
